Job Description
 Who are we?
 At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.
 We are now looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our team in Cluj-Napoca, Romania!
 The Global Software Reporting team supports the company’s strategic operations by developing reports and automatizing the process of data collection used for big data analysis. The team develops and tests the functionality of electronic test forms and reports. Form development includes developing user interfaces that perform calculations, lay-out modifications, user input validations, form intelligence/logic decisions and output reports based on site condition and historical data. Testing a form requires a good understanding of the form logic, validations and systems.
 The Senior Test Engineer develops test cases based on requirements, verifies the implemented forms, maintains the test cases, creates documented defects, provides test reports and risk analysis and provide inputs for possible improvements. In this context the senior tester will work closely with the development team, PM, BA and POs. The senior tester will work under direction and supervision of the local project team leader. Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
 What will you be expected to do to reach success & optimal performance?
Own system testing through the whole STLC process;
Be involved in the design and specification process to ensure project plans are viable and the best approach to meet the business objectives is selected;
Test the global reporting forms, customer reports/report engine, and the whole system
Ensure implementation of the user interface adheres to human-centered design principles and branding standards;
Provide testing estimates based on functional specifications;
Foster a collaborative environment 
Manage and update current work efforts as recorded in User Stories and tasks within Rally and JIRA;
Collaborate with the team and peers to ensure clearly defined defects and testing scenarios
Adhere to testing standards, procedures, and documentation;
Create reusable test cases for common functionality and reduce maintenance costs;
Assist in identifying and mitigating risks throughout the testing lifecycle;
Provide continuous improvement ideas regarding testing scenarios, procedures, and documentation;
Provide technical recommendations and support to product management Pos/BAs, and fellow engineers;
Create project documentation (including testing files and testing results)
Create test reports and risk analysis
Maintain good communication with developers, BA, and POs
Report test results to the supervisor and/or colleagues clearly and concisely.
Provide user training on forms and tools
 Education
 What will make you successful now:
BSc, or MSc in Computer Science or other technical discipline;
 Language Skills
Business English B2
 Experience
5+ years of software testing experience with a trackable record of accomplishments;
 Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Experience in the agile development methodology;
Mentor, train, and support junior testers and peers
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
SDLC. STLC knowledge
Experienced with JIRA/Rally project tracking tools
Pre-study, analyze, and understand customer requirements to design and implement test cases while suggesting best practices for requirements format and testing techniques
Design and update test cases
Interpret and execute sets of test cases using agreed methods and standards.
Check test results and document failures and successes compared with pre-determined criteria.
Identify/suggest form, feature, and application improvements on each form revised.
Update and interact with Rally/JIRA (project and issue tracking platforms), and address issues/problems raised by users.
Focused on a highly responsive service-oriented interface for users.
Multi-platforms and multi-devices testing: web, Windows, iOS, Android.
